name: Manufacturing
seoTitle: AI & Software Solutions for Manufacturing | Fruition
seoDescription: 47 manufacturing use cases on monday.com, 5 with AI. See the process, boards, automations and integrations for each.
heading: Manufacturing use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do manufacturing organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 47 manufacturing use cases. The most common are work & project management (35), integrations & migration (33), CRM (29), most often for sales & CRM, operations & delivery, projects & PMO teams.

faq.question: How long does a manufacturing monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete manufacturing build is 6 weeks to 3 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do manufacturing builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in manufacturing use cases are Make, Xero, SharePoint, HubSpot, Microsoft Teams, Outlook calendar.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for manufacturing?
faq.answer: Yes. 5 of the manufacturing use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: AI add-on licensed as part of the proposal (use not detailed); Job sheet PDF submitted → AI extracts specs and materials into the job (Job Intake Agent); AI-assisted demand forecasting for production scheduling (discussed, aspirational).
